Use case: precise-object-edit. One native high-resolution transparent PNG for WEST run frame 10. Edit IMAGE1 ONLY. Image1 is the exact frame10 placement and pose. Its large sleeve must overlap/occlude part of chest collar/taiji ornament; do not force all chest decorations visible. Anatomical RIGHT is the FAR shoulder hidden on neck-left behind the chest. Keep the far rightmost ribbon end safely inside the existing canvas; if needed bend only that tip inward, no figure movement.

Polished black-gold brocade and teal Q-style materials unchanged. Blank scroll, no text. True transparent background; square canvas at least1024x1024 with transparent border around every ribbon/prop. Do not turn the head/body front-on, do not show the back torso, do not exchange hands or props. Output just the one corrected independent frame10.
Exactly two sleeves, each ending in its one real hand. The near LEFT crossing sleeve is one continuous solid sleeve from the near shoulder to the scroll cuff; no intermediate open empty cuff or third sleeve on the chest.
